english: Jury-rigged portal projector. Left click blue, right click orange. One colour is inert until the pair is complete. Unlock: read Wiring magazines to Electrician 25, and put perk points in Advanced Engineering. Craft at a workbench.

Industrial sprayer. Left click lays blue repulsion gel (bounce when you jump or land on it — height follows how hard you came in). Right click lays orange propulsion gel (speeds you up when you walk or run on it). Same unlock as the portal gun.

Knee-high scavenged fall-arrest boots. Wear them in the feet slot to ignore fall damage — needed if you are bouncing on blue gel. Unlock: Electrician 25 and Advanced Engineering. Craft at a workbench.
Welded steel crate with a heart stencil. Heavy, pickup-able, and useful as a prop or ballast. Craft at a workbench after Electrician 25 / Advanced Engineering.
Use to read how the portal kit unlocks and fires. Not used up.

PORTAL KIT
Unlock by reading Wiring magazines until Electrician reaches 25, and spend perk points in Advanced Engineering. Craft at a workbench.

PORTAL GUN
Left click blue, right click orange. A lone portal is a static opening. Place both colours and they link — walk through and you come out the other with facing and speed transformed. Linked portals show the view through the partner.

GEL GUN
Left click blue repulsion gel: jump or land on it to bounce; the higher you come in, the higher you go. Right click orange propulsion gel: walking or running on it speeds you up.

LONG-FALL BOOTS
Feet slot. Ignore fall damage. Wear these before you bounce off high blue gel.

WEIGHTED CUBE
Place and pick up. Scrap-steel crate with a heart on it.

SURFACES
Full non-terrain cubes only. Dirt, plants, wedges, doors, and plates reject.

ADMIN
hsportal give / room / blue / orange / gel blue / gel orange / clear / status
